build_octconv_layer: build a Gluon model using Octave Conv2D with high and low frequency feature paths
create_activation_block: create an Activation block that applies relu to both high and low frequency features
build_batchnorm_block: build a BatchNorm block that normalizes high and low frequency feature maps separately
create_adapter_block: create an Adapter block that upsamples low frequency features and concatenates them to high frequency
build_se_block: build a Squeeze-and-Excitation block that applies channel attention to high and low frequency features
